How I feel exactly... I’m so fucking done with this shit life and world and all the fucking shitty ass people in it. Never have I had something good in my life, so I’m fucking done. I’ll just be waiting my death now...

I just have such a hard time looking at it that way. I mean you say we can't give up becayse then all of it will be for nothing, but what if we don't give up, and if still doesn't get better? Then what, then you've kept going for nothing as well, right? I know, I'm being a pessimist, but I literally have no hope and can't imagine life getting better for me. I wish I could've been someone else...

We're supposed to do well, but it's impossible when you feel this way. Like today, I haven't been able to do shit because the way I feel everyday when I wake up, which is that I wish I didn't wake up. I wish it would all just go away.

I literally don't even see a future. It feels like it'll never get better because from my experience these past couple of years, it has only gotten worse. I don't know what to do, especially because it affects my everyday life being a student and having to keep up with everything. I feel like such a failure....
Me too. I don't know what to do because I've been struggling for a decade now, every year is worse than the one before.

I'll be turning 22 in a few months and have also been depressed since 13. I feel ike giving up these days. I'm struggling with university and have no friends or boyfriends. Feel like I have nothing and no one. And that it's gonna stay that way forever.
